abilities.effect: Each living creature within 60 feet must succeed at a DC 23 Will save or be subjected to the pharaoh’s curse. A cursed creature takes a –2 status penalty to Fortitude saves, and any natural or magical healing it receives is halved. The curse remains until removed by *cleanse affliction* or similar magic.
abilities.name: Curse the Intruders

traits.name: Curse
traits.text: A curse is an effect that places some long-term affliction on a creature. Curses are always magical and are typically the result of a spell or trap. Effects with this trait can be removed only by effects that specifically target curses.

traits.name: Divine
traits.text:
This magic comes from the divine tradition, drawing power from deities or similar sources. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to divine magic.

abilities.trigger: The seal on the tomb is broken from the outside

hazard.description: A curse is imbued on an entryway’s threshold.
hazard.disable: DC 27 Thievery (master) to painstakingly remove the lintel without triggering the magic, or *dispel magic* (4th rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract the rune
hazard.name: Pharaoh's Ward
hazard.reset: The trap resets when the door is shut.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
